opener_error_transfer_added_term_vs_base.classification_evidence: Interval crosses zero (P+=0.76); per-fold LOSO betas for cfb_transfer_logit flip sign across the 6 NFL seasons (-0.0098,+0.0009,-0.0084,-0.0405,-0.0236,+0.0135), an order of magnitude smaller than the stable base four-term coefficients; in-sample-minus-OOS accuracy gap -0.00067 (no overfitting); split-half reliability 0.141, not zero, so no_split_half_reliability is not admissible either
opener_error_transfer_added_term_vs_base.description: CFB-trained opener-error logit (13-season, 4301-game, two-book widened training set) added as a 5th fitted term to the served four-term NFL pick probability, LOSO by season, vs the four-term base

opener_error_transfer_nflonly_vs_cfbdire.classification_evidence: Interval crosses zero (P+=0.58), wide because it compares two already-noisy standalone predictors; cannot yet separate a CFB-transfer-specific cost from a generic feature-set cost; in-sample-minus-OOS accuracy gap +0.018 (no overfitting)
opener_error_transfer_nflonly_vs_cfbdire.description: NFL-only-trained 5-feature twin vs CFB-trained-direct on the same features, widened CFB (13-season, 4301-game) population; isolates transfer cost from feature-set cost
